paper_metadata.title: Achievement of Ultralow Elastic Modulus through Optimization of Phase Stability and Recrystallization Texture in Ti–Nb–Fe–Sn Alloys

evidence.quote: Ti–Nb–Fe–Sn alloys with relatively low Nb content, located near the phase boundary of (β + ω)/β, are designed on the basis of electron-to-atom (e/a) ratio, d-electron alloy design concept, and Mo equivalent (Mo eq) aiming at low Young’s modulus comparable to human bone.

evidence.quote: Ti–5Nb–3Fe–(0–6)Sn and Ti–(3–9)Nb–3Fe–4Sn (at%) ... alloys were fabricated by an Ar arc-melting method using high-purity raw materials. During the melting process, each alloy ingot was inverted and remelted six times to ensure homogeneity of the composition.
The button-shaped arc melted ingots were homogenized at 1273 K for 7.2 ks in vacuum.

parameters.cooling_method: water quenching by breaking quartz tube

evidence.quote: plates were cut from the homogenized button-shaped ingots using an electrodischarge machine and were encapsulated in a quartz tube in an Ar atmosphere and then solution-treated at 1273 K for 7.2 ks, followed by water quenching by breaking the quartz tube in water.
The plates were then cold-rolled into sheets with a final reduction of 95%. The final thickness of all the cold-rolled sheets was approximately about 0.20 mm.

parameters.cooling_method: water quenching by breaking quartz tube

process_steps.output_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: Finally, the cold-rolled specimens were encapsulated in quartz tubes in an Ar atmosphere and were subjected to heat treatment at 1073 K for 1.8 ks and then were quenched in water by breaking the quartz tubes.

phases_and_microstructures.name: beta phase
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: all the Ti–5Nb–3Fe–(0–6)Sn and Ti–(3–9)Nb–3Fe–4Sn alloys consist of only a single β phase.

phases_and_microstructures.name: athermal omega phase
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: diffraction spots of the ω phase were clearly observed ... in Ti–5Nb–3Fe, Ti–5Nb–3Fe–2Sn, and Ti–5Nb–3Fe–4Sn alloys ... a large amount of ω phase was uniformly dispersed in the β phase matrix

phases_and_microstructures.name: athermal omega phase
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: the size and volume fraction of the ω phase were reduced significantly in the Ti–5Nb–3Fe–4Sn alloy

phases_and_microstructures.name: equiaxed grain structure
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: All alloys consisted of single β phase with an equiaxed structure and the average grain size of the alloys was measured to be 51, 51, 54, 56, and 66 μm, respectively

phases_and_microstructures.name: Goss texture
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: The Ti–5Nb–3Fe–2Sn alloy exhibited a very strong {110}β<001>β texture, which is known as the Goss texture.

phases_and_microstructures.name: Goss texture
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: A strong {110}β<001>β texture was also formed in the Ti–4Nb–3Fe–4Sn alloy

phases_and_microstructures.name: gamma-fiber texture
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: The {110}β<001>β component became very weak in the Ti–6Nb–3Fe–4Sn alloy, instead a weak γ-fiber texture with a maximum intensity at {111}β<110>β was observed.

phases_and_microstructures.name: weak texture
phases_and_microstructures.material_state: heat-treated at 1073 K for 1.8 ks then water quenched

evidence.quote: the Ti–5Nb–3Fe alloy exhibited a very weak texture with a maximum intensity (Imax) of 4 close to the {001}β<110>β component.

evidence.quote: the diffraction spots of the ω phase in the diffraction patterns became weaker and its volume fraction shown in dark-field images decreased with increasing Nb content
